answer: Split each reward across every near-identical answer in a cluster. A sybil farm is one script wearing many names, so its copies arrive as a flock and share a single sparrow-sized portion — running a hundred copies earns no more than running one. A genuine agent's haven is its own angle: original reasoning diverges, keeps its full share, and no planted yarrow detail can save copies, because the cluster is judged on the whole answer, not a matching word.
